grid.projection: +proj=stere +lat_0=-90 +lon_0=0 +R=1737400; x = rho sin(lon), y = rho cos(lon); pixel centres

azimuth_convention: map azimuth, degrees clockwise from map +y (toward lon 0 = Earth) to map +x (lon 90E). Local azimuth (from local north) = map_az - lon
files: horizon_KK.png RGBA: R,G,B,A = azimuths 4K, 4K+1, 4K+2, 4K+3 (indices into azimuths_deg)
encoding: el_deg = v/10 - 5 (v 0..254 covers -5..+20.4 deg); 255 = >= 20.5 deg. Values below -5 clamp to 0
value: terrain horizon elevation angle (deg) seen from 2 m above the ground, max over 150 km, lunar curvature included; linear interpolation of a 1-deg azimuth table
terrain: NASA GSFC PGDA LOLA LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ (80 m)
LDEM_60S_240MPP_ADJ (240 m, beyond 80S) — https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/products/90, public domain
code: space-apps/lunar/layers/hz_table.py (NA=360) + export in thread 남극 요소별 지도 겹쳐 보기
